categories_thin: Optometry: only two independent eye-care practices in the zone (Old Bridge Vision Center on US-9, and Associated Vision Care on Washington Rd, which exists in directories only). Visionworks at 426 Raritan St and BJ's Optical are chains and were excluded

Orthodontics: no standalone independent orthodontic practice found in Sayreville/Parlin. Braces are offered by Dental City Sayreville and Apex Dental (included as dentists); the orthodontic office listed at 2909 Washington Rd trades as Eastern Orthodontic Associates, part of the multi-site Eastern Dental group, so it was excluded

Podiatry: the Sayreville foot-care office at 53 Main St is a location of a multi-site New Jersey podiatry group (Advanced Feet & Ankle Care / Nexus Foot & Ankle), so it was excluded under the multi-site rule; no solo podiatry practice in town surfaced

Dermatology and other medical specialties: no confirmable independent specialty office in town. Choice Dermatology (1145 Bordentown Ave, Parlin) appears in insurer directories but is not among the three locations listed on its current website, so it was not listed

Med spas: thin - Prestige Beauty by Mayara is the only Sayreville aesthetics business with a local address; Anara Medspa's Sayreville page is a service-area page for an East Brunswick location and was excluded
Mental health counseling: most Sayreville counselor listings are telehealth-only sole practitioners or NPI mailing addresses, so only Wise Counsel Services has both an address and an active site

Yoga and Pilates: no dedicated studio open in the zone. Precision Sculpt Pilates lists 388 Washington Rd, Sayreville as 'coming soon' on its own site, and Sayreville's municipal recreation yoga classes are a public programme

Physical therapy: after removing the multi-site groups, only one independent PT practice remains in the zone (A & A Physical Therapy on US-9); the other visible clinics at 2909 and 3276 Washington Rd are chain or hospital-affiliated
caveats: Consistent chain rule applied in this revision: businesses with roughly ten or more locations are excluded as regional chains - Twin Boro Physical Therapy (about 50 NJ offices), Garden State Physical Therapy Group (10+ offices), Satori Academy of Martial Arts (8 NJ branches plus Staten Island) and the Eastern Dental / Eastern Orthodontic / Kessler / Hair Cuttery / Hand & Stone / Retro Fitness / Visionworks locations. Small local groups of two or three offices (Apex Dental, Dr. Silman Smiles Spa, AMG Family Dentistry) are kept and flagged in notes
The Aquatics & Fitness Center at 333 Cheesequake Rd is operated by the Educational Services Commission of New Jersey, a public agency, so it was removed from the list
Google Maps returned a limited (roughly 4-result) list per query without signing in, so Maps coverage here is a floor, not a full census

Several BestProsInTown profiles are cross-filed under neighboring towns (Old Bridge, Edison, South Amboy) even when the street address is Sayreville; town field follows the street address, not the directory's filing
US-9 / Bordentown Ave addresses near the Old Bridge line (1018 US-9, 1026 US-9, 1040 US-9, 984 US-9, 4500 Bordentown Ave) need a municipal boundary check before outreach
Two Birdeye 'dentist' entries carried malformed addresses (postal code 110034, not a New Jersey ZIP) and were excluded rather than guessed

Shared-address entries (152 Main St salon suites, 811 Washington Rd, 2909 Washington Rd, 777 Washington Rd, 1400 Main St, 236 Ernston Rd, 53 Main St) may be separate suites or booth renters - listed separately and flagged where they look related
Individual barbers and stylists who rent booths and are listed only on booking platforms were not listed as separate businesses
Hair by Cris LLC is not listed separately: its booking listing shows the same address and phone as Miracle Beauty Salon (389 Washington Rd), so the two are recorded as one entry with a note

Ratings and review counts carried over from the first research pass were read from map and aggregator listings at that time and were not re-checked line by line in this revision; they are indicative only
data_gaps: OpenStreetMap/Overpass was not used - the API is typically blocked here and the brief said not to spend time on it

YellowPages, AllPages, Superpages and Manta partially or fully returned HTTP 403 from this environment, so their full category lists could not be read; individual profile URLs were used only where a search engine returned them
Sayreville Borough's own site has no public directory of licensed health or personal-care businesses that could be read

Core Physical Therapy (previously listed at 777 Washington Rd) was dropped: the directories now disagree on both the address (777 vs 2909 Washington Rd) and which practice owns the phone number, and no own site or map listing could be confirmed
Self-Care Counseling LLC (82 Canal St) was dropped: NPI-registry and insurer-directory entries only, with no public commercial presence in Sayreville that could be opened

The Delta Dental network finder for Sayreville renders its results with JavaScript and would not show street addresses, so the Parlin entries it returned could not be matched to addresses or confirmed
The Kwfamilydental.com site returned HTTP 503 on repeated attempts and the practice's public site could not be read
Phone numbers are Unknown for many listings - they were left blank rather than guessed; the triage team can pull them from each business's site
